2461.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

2464.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $n!

2527.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
2527.text1: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

2529.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?
2529.text1: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

2824.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.
2824.text1: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2825.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.
2825.text1: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

2828.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.
2828.text1: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

3003.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.
3003.text1: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

3011.text: I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.$B$BWhat can I do for you, $n?

3901.text: Hello, $n! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

4139.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

4350.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

4584.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.
4584.text1: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

4617.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
4617.text1: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

4619.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
4619.text1: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

4621.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
4621.text1: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

4660.text1: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

4784.text: Thuwd will show you how to skin your kills.  Look for him at Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag.
4784.text1: Thuwd will show you how to skin your kills.  Look for him at Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag.

4792.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

4963.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.
4963.text1: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin

5482.text: Life is a struggle, and the saying that which does not kill you makes you stronger is not always true.  Sometimes wounds act slowly, which is why we have bandages.  Pand Stonebinder of the Spirit Rise can teach you the art of First Aid.
5482.text1: Life is a struggle, and the saying that which does not kill you makes you stronger is not always true.  Sometimes wounds act slowly, which is why we have bandages.  Pand Stonebinder of the Spirit Rise can teach you the art of First Aid.

5942.text: I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.$B$BHe claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

5943.text: I thank you, $n. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.$B$BI cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.$B$BNow I must begin to rebuild my life.

5969.text: Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.$B$BPlease, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.$B$BThere are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

6070.text: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

6077.text: My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.$B$BLong ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>$B$BGreat thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

6567.text: Dhugru Gorelust is hiding behind the barracks on the east side of town.  Don't let me find out that you're in league with the Burning Legion!
6567.text1: Dhugru Gorelust is hiding behind the barracks on the east side of town.  Don't let me find out that you're in league with the Burning Legion!

6751.text: You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs in a room at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast side of Brill.
6751.text1: You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs in a room at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast side of Brill.

7057.text: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?
7057.text1: The skinners usually take all their hides into Ironforge to dry out.  Why don't you head there and see if you can find one to train ye?

7164.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $n? Training perhaps?
7164.text1: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $n? Training perhaps?

7214.text: Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.$B$BI deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

7217.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

7218.text: All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $n. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.$B$BIt is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.$B$BUnderstand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

7228.text: Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

7260.text: It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.$B$BKnow this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.$B$BMany cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.$B$BGroups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

7262.text: Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.$B$BThat fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

7263.text: Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!$B$BLook at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

7264.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

7265.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

7460.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.
7460.text1: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

7529.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

7584.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

7586.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

7710.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

7829.text: Hmm... well, I can't help you quite yet! You have to learn the basics first. Why don't you go see Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind!

7834.text: You can learn from me in time... but not yet! Why don't you start out by talking to Sprite Jumpsprocket to my right here. You can check in with me after you've gotten your feet wet!

7841.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

7843.text: Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

7922.text: Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

7962.text1: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

7964.text1: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

7988.text: Not bad... I suppose training you is not out of the question. Very well! Let's begin...

8013.text: I am pleased with your progress so far. Surely the Earth Mother has inspired your hands.

8023.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

8077.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. May I help you?

8094.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8111.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

8116.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

8120.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8146.text1: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

8243.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

8257.text: If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.$B$BIf you want something, make it quick.

8258.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

8289.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.
8289.text1: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.

8364.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

8402.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.
8402.text1: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

8453.text1: As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

8777.text1: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

8810.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

8862.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

9685.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!
9685.text1: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

9688.text: I can teach you how to cook!
9688.text1: I can teach you how to cook!

9701.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.
9701.text1: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

9891.text: Hail $g brother : sister;... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.$B$BWe tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

10029.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10031.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10032.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $n.

10753.text: Where would you like to fly to?
10753.text1: Where would you like to fly to?

212752.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.
212752.text1: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

250597.text1: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

276311.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!
276311.text1: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

290402.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.
290402.text1: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

292961.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

296783.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

299234.text1: Praise to the Banshee Queen, it isn't often I have visitors out here.

299683.text: Hail and well met, traveler.$B$BI wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

299703.text:
Unfortunately, the rumor of our plight is true. Disruptions to our leylines have unveiled a disturbance amongst the arcane forces of our city.

With Dalaran on the cusp of reopening its borders to our allies, we are in dire need of immediate solutions.

300665.text1: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

301834.text: There won't be an explosion. The detonator I gave you was designed to fail.

301836.text: SI:7 will take things from here. The forge and warship you liberated from the Defias have strategic value and we are taking control of them.

301837.text1: You don't understand. That forge is poisoning the farms of Westfall! If it isn't destroyed, nothing will grow here for generations. You're risking a major famine!

301838.text: Thank you for your concern, elf, but this is now a Stormwind internal matter. Your help is no longer needed at this time.

302214.text:
The full story requires time that I suspect you do not have, so I will attempt to be brief.

Perhaps the simplest way I can put it: these crystals are anchors. They can be used to permanently--well, so long as the crystals hold I suppose--bind something, someone, or even somewhere onto our plane of Azeroth. Prince Tortheldrin ordered the creation of similar pylons when he chose to bind the demon Immol'thar. Some of the Shen'dralar protested this decision and proposed a compelling alternative, but ultimately the prince was uninterested in debate and eager to silence dissent.

I had an opportunity to study their design before it became too unsafe for me to stay within the city's walls and I fled back to Shen'dralas.

302215.text:
The proposed alternative to demonic entanglement was at odds with what Tortheldrin had already set in motion. Given that he was working with power that tends to cloud one's judgment, it's no surprise that his first instinct was to lash out.

Most everyone who pushed back against his plans to summon and bind a demon were slain that day. Some escaped, including some of my own kin that stood in opposition to the prince, but I have yet to meet other survivors of that schism even after all these thousands of years.

305021.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.
305021.text1: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

307136.text:
This was once a part of Eldre'Thalas - the ancient city of my people that lies just over the southern mountains. Dire Maul, I believe it is commonly called these days. Perhaps you have heard of it.

Over time, the elements have worn away at our marvelous structures and smothered our gardens. I yearn to return to the halls of Eldre'Thalas, but I am still haunted by memories of the past.

For now, I am content merely watching over these lands and reminiscing over what once was.

309779.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

310718.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.
310718.text1: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

310771.text: They are going to see somethin' really scary!

313248.text: Go on and have a seat near the fire and we can get started.

313249.text: All you need to start a camp of your own is a basic campfire. Cooks can generally teach you how to make one of those.

313250.text: Once your campfire is down, you can place all sorts of camp fixtures around it.

313251.text: Sufficiently skilled leatherworkers, for example, can place a tent like this one behind me.

313253.text: Every trade has something they can contribute to your camp, even fishermen!

313254.text: Then, all you need to do is have a seat near the fire and soak it all in. After a few minutes of resting, you'll gain various boons that will help you in your travels.

313255.text: If you just sit still and rest for a few more moments, you'll gain a benefit from having rested near the tent I have set up behind me.

313256.text: That's about the gist of it. Once you've gained your boon from resting near the fire, speak with me again.

313610.text:
I'm inclined to agree. Despite our people coming together to survive the Great Sundering it seems as though the city was nonetheless doomed. How pedantic is it that its fall from grace would come from something so mundane as internal strife?

My loyalty was unquestionable in those days, but in the years since I've come to realize that the rebellion was the moment that we truly lost Prince Tortheldrin. Everything that came after is but a consequence of that wound upon his soul.
 
For my part, I try to avoid dwelling on the past, particularly my role in those events.

Try as I might though... it still haunts me.

313613.text:
Celebrating my own life as I stare toward the mass grave of so many of my kin feels... selfish. Many among my order remain cloistered in Prince Tortheldrin's inner sanctum, I suspect to hide from their own guilt. Seeing the city from this perspective makes it difficult to avoid painful truths.

I still count myself among the Shen'dralar, but these days I am long estranged from the library I once called home.

314765.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.
314765.text1:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

316076.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

317087.text: Wanna join a battle out in Darkspear Islands?
317087.text1: Wanna join a battle out in Darkspear Islands?

321007.text1: Oh, Jornah should be somewhere around the camp. If you have questions, she would be happy to answer them.

325825.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

326579.text: Us is busy with important things!

326951.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.
326951.text1: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

327777.text1: <The great cat stretches its long, nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.>

327783.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

327796.text: <The raptor turns to fix you with two vibrant orange eyes.>

327804.text: <Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you.>
327804.text1:
<The wolf turns its head to regard you as you draw near. Even through the visor on its helm, you can feel its gaze as it studies you. It sniffs you gently, and after a moment lets out a low but not unfriendly growl in recognition. 

 
It stands up straighter, seemingly to show off the heavy armor adorning its body. The freshly polished metal gleams, even under a coat of Durotar dust kicked up by the hot winds. 

Something within you stirs and you sense that this wolf approves of your bravery and would be proud to bear you as its friend and rider.>

327805.text: <As you approach this wolf it shakes its great head; its armor glints gently against its ashen fur.>

327806.text: <The wolf stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor.>
327806.text1:
<Just as the freshly hewed timbers of a cedar tree fade from red to grey, so too has this timber wolf's fur changed with maturity. Its once boisterous personality is focused, and it stands tall and strong, even with the added weight of the armor. 
 
Its long tail still wags in familiarity as you approach and lets out a knowing whine. Through the glowing enchantment of the helmet's visor, you see its eyes shine with determination; its thirst for adventure is undiminished. 

After a moment it lets out an excited growl. You get the sense that this wolf admires your adventurous spirit and is impressed by all the challenges you have surmounted. It would gladly accept you as a rider and companion.>

327809.text: Oh aye, up in the back of the tavern there's a visitor from Aerie Peak who can probably help you with spiritual guidance or whatever it is that shamans do. Ingol? Ir... Ingrid! That was her name, Ingrid.
327809.text1: Oh aye, up in the back of the tavern there's a visitor from Aerie Peak who can probably help you with spiritual guidance or whatever it is that shamans do. Ingol? Ir... Ingrid! That was her name, Ingrid.

328220.text:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.
328220.text1:

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

328221.text:
Not to worry, the barbershop just northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

They'll have ye looking sharp in no time!
328221.text1:
Not to worry, the barbershop just northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

They'll have ye looking sharp in no time!

328240.text:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.
328240.text1:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.

328241.text: One must take care of themselves before entering the temple. Do stop by the barber, you will find them at the Tradesman's Terrace.
328241.text1: One must take care of themselves before entering the temple. Do stop by the barber, you will find them at the Tradesman's Terrace.

328287.text: Horns need sharpening, hm? You will find a goblin who can aid you on the lowest section of the central bluff.
328287.text1: Horns need sharpening, hm? You will find a goblin who can aid you on the lowest section of the central bluff.

328288.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

329302.text: Hidden within their impregnable stronghold of Ironforge mountain, they rarely ventured beyond the wintry peaks of Dun Morogh.

329312.text: Ruled by the child king Anduin Wrynn, the people of Stormwind remain steadfast in their commitment to the Grand Alliance.

329336.text: Scattered across the lands, the wandering tribes were united only by their common hatred for their sworn enemy--the marauding centaur.

329343.text: The vicious trolls that populate the numerous jungle isles of the South Seas are renowned for their cruelty and dark mysticism.
